name: IT team · M1 demo PRE-FLIGHT — last live check of the stack 45 min before the 13:00Z slot
description:
GAP THIS CARD CLOSES (found by the ProjectManager, shift #6, 2026-11-19): on demo day the last time anyone touches the running stack is the 09:00Z rehearsal (`101588b6`). The demo is at 14:00 Madrid = 13:00Z. Between them, `def4ce38` records the walkthrough at 11:00Z and `4f055e99` only fires if the rehearsal FAILED. So if the rehearsal passes and the environment then drifts (container restarted, port taken, `.env` changed, laptop slept), nobody is watching. This is the classic "we rehearsed in the morning" failure.

WHEN: wake 2026-11-21T12:15:00Z = 13:15 Madrid, 45 minutes before the slot. Hard stop 12:45Z: whatever the state, report it by then.

DO (fast, in this order, and nothing else):
1. `docker ps` — every container the demo needs is `Up`, none restarting. Paste the output.
2. `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' <platform URL>` → expect `200`.
3. One screenshot: the login page loads and, if a session is still valid, the workspace list renders. Use `qa_explorer`'s `start_session`/`get_screenshot`. One screenshot, not a full walkthrough — `def4ce38` already owns the recorded run.
4. Confirm `demo/up.sh` on disk is the frozen version (no diff since 2026-11-20T17:30Z): `project_changes(paths=["demo/up.sh"], scope="all")`.

RULING IF IT IS RED:
- If it can be fixed in under 10 minutes without editing any file (restart a container, free a port, restart Compose), fix it and re-run step 1-2.
- If the fix needs a file edit, DO NOT edit: `demo/` is frozen after the CISO allow at 2026-11-20T17:30Z. Report and hand to `4f055e99` / the PM.
- If it cannot be fixed by 12:45Z, comment **`PRE-FLIGHT RED — demo at risk`** with the evidence and do not attempt a heroic rebuild: a half-rebuilt stack 20 minutes before a demo is worse than a stale-green one.

ACCEPTANCE: a comment with the four outputs above and a one-line verdict `PRE-FLIGHT GREEN` or `PRE-FLIGHT RED`. If red, the reason in one sentence and who is notified.

PROFILES: `devops` (Docker/Compose/host access — the only seat with `docker_ps`/`docker_exec`) + `qa_explorer` (the only seat with a browser screenshot). `web_master` must not be assigned: it has no Docker and no browser.

SCOPE: read and restart only. No code edits, no `demo/` edits, no rebuild from source.

## PM correction — YOU are the NO-GO authority for your own time window

One sentence I wrote when creating this card is wrong, and it is the most important thing on the card.

It says: *if the stack is not healthy, hand the decision to `4f055e99`.* That is impossible. `4f055e99` is the NO-GO branch for the **09:00Z rehearsal** and its only wake is **10:30Z**. By the time you run (12:15Z) that card has already closed with the rehearsal verdict. Between 10:30Z and the 13:00Z demo there is nothing on the board except you.

So the ruling is **pre-authorised here**. You do not need to escalate to decide it.

- **12:15Z–12:45Z, stack healthy** (`docker_ps` shows the services up, the demo URL answers, login renders): comment `PRE-FLIGHT: GREEN` with the evidence and close. The demo runs live.
- **Not healthy at 12:45Z:** comment `PRE-FLIGHT: RED` with the actual failure, then **switch the slot to the recorded walkthrough** produced at 11:00Z by `def4ce38`, and say so in the same comment. One line in the demo channel: *"Live demo replaced by the recorded walkthrough (reason). M1 is unaffected — the environment failed, not the increment."*
- **12:45Z–13:00Z is emergency-only.** A single restart is allowed if it takes under 5 minutes. Do **not** rebuild from source, do not edit `demo/`, do not re-run `up.sh --build`. A heroic 15-minute rebuild in front of management is worse than a recording.

Publish the explicit one-line `GO` / `NO-GO` verdict either way. The 13:00Z slot runs on your comment, not on optimism.

Why one card and not a new one: I am on the final turn of this shift, the chain already holds 25 cards, and a decision card armed at 12:45Z would collide with the demo itself. You carry the authority instead — same pattern as `101588b6` carrying the 09:00Z GO/NO-GO one-liner.

(Filed by the ProjectManager, shift #6, 2026-11-19. `b9aaf03c` owns the script; you own only the live state of the stack.)
